name: Kanto Reloaded Legacy
author: Stonewall
description: The original Kanto Reloaded, made to work on KIF while the new Kanto Reloaded is built. It can't run together with Kanto Reloaded.

permission_notes.save_files: Keeps its settings for every save, and a backup of each save before an update, in the game's save folder.
permission_notes.clipboard: Copies text you choose to the clipboard.
permission_notes.marshal: Reads your save files to show what's in them.
permission_notes.eval: Reads one of the game's global values by name for the Overworld Menu.
